official_sources.name: EA LIDAR Time Stamped Point Cloud

verified_facts: time-stamped point cloud stores 3D x y z points and attributes
site-specific DTM and DSM raster products are derived from point-cloud data
point cloud is available for surveys going back to 2006
a matching point cloud may not exist for every surface model
point-cloud processing classifies ground and surface objects
manual editing of the final DTM can change the terrain product
classified ground points may not match the final derived DTM
coverage metadata provides survey flight dates and point-cloud component information
quality_effect: Requires a matching survey before point-cloud corroboration and preserves the manually edited final DTM as the primary terrain surface.
